Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Siren's Ruse to your hand.

When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Warden of the Eye, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the token Molderhulk trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
